verses.sloka: कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य युधाजित्केकयो नृपः ।स्वगुरुं प्रेषयामास राघवाय महात्मने ।गार्ग्यमङ्गिरसः पुत्रं ब्रह्मर्षिममितप्रभम् ।। ७.१००.१ ॥
verses.transliteration: kasyacittvatha kālasya yudhājitkekayo nṛpaḥ ।svaguruṁ preṣayāmāsa rāghavāya mahātmane ।gārgyamaṅgirasaḥ putraṁ brahmarṣimamitaprabham ।। 7.100.1 ॥

translations.english: Then, after some time, King Yudhājit of Kekaya sent his own preceptor, Gārgya, the son of Angiras, a Brahmarshi of immeasurable splendor, to the great-souled Rama.

verses.sloka: दश चाश्वसहस्राणि प्रीतिदानमनुत्तमम् ।। ७.१००.२ ॥
verses.transliteration: daśa cāśvasahasrāṇi prītidānamanuttamam ।। 7.100.2 ॥

translations.english: And ten thousand horses, an unsurpassed gift of affection, were also sent.
translations.hindi: दोनों भाई भरत और लक्ष्मण को आया हुआ देख, श्रीरामचन्द्र जी उनसे मिले भेंटे । तदनन्तर श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ने उन दोनों से कहा

verses.sloka: कम्बलानि च रत्नानि चित्रवस्त्रमथोत्तमम् ।रामाय प्रददौ राजा शुभान्याभरणानि च ।। ७.१००.३ ॥
verses.transliteration: kambalāni ca ratnāni citravastramathottamam ।rāmāya pradadau rājā śubhānyābharaṇāni ca ।। 7.100.3 ॥

translations.english: The king also gave blankets, jewels, excellent colorful garments, and auspicious ornaments to Rama.

verses.sloka: श्रुत्वा तु राघवो धीमान्महर्षिं गार्ग्यमागतम् ।मातुलस्याश्वपतिनः प्रहितं तन्महाधनम् ।। ७.१००.४ ॥
verses.transliteration: śrutvā tu rāghavo dhīmānmaharṣiṁ gārgyamāgatam ।mātulasyāśvapatinaḥ prahitaṁ tanmahādhanam ।। 7.100.4 ॥

translations.english: The intelligent Rama, having heard that the great sage Gargya, sent by his maternal uncle Ashvapati with great wealth, had arrived.
translations.hindi: क्योंकि में तो राजसूययज्ञ को अक्षय्य एवं अविनाशी पुण्यफल प्रदाता और समस्त पापों का नाश करने वाला समता हूँ

verses.sloka: प्रत्युद्गम्य च काकुत्स्थः क्रोशमात्रं सहानुजः ।गार्ग्यं सम्पूजयामास यथा शक्रो बृहस्पतिम् ।। ७.१००.५ ॥
verses.transliteration: pratyudgamya ca kākutsthaḥ krośamātraṁ sahānujaḥ ।gārgyaṁ sampūjayāmāsa yathā śakro bṛhaspatim ।। 7.100.5 ॥

translations.english: And Rama, along with his younger brothers, went forth for a krosa to meet Gargya and honored him greatly, just as Indra honors Brihaspati.
translations.hindi: आतः में तुम दोनों भाइयों की सहायता से यज्ञो में श्रेष्ठ इस राजसूययज्ञ को करना चाहता हूँ । क्योंकि उसमें स्थायी सनातन धर्म है । अथवा राजसूययज्ञ करने से अक्षय्य धे फल या पुण्यफल की प्राप्ति होती है

verses.sloka: तथा सम्पूज्य तमृषिं तद्धनं प्रतिगृह्य च ।पृष्ट्वा प्रतिपदं सर्वं कुशलं मातुलस्य च ।उपविष्टं महाभागं रामः प्रष्टुं प्रचक्रमे ।। ७.१००.६ ॥
verses.transliteration: tathā sampūjya tamṛṣiṁ taddhanaṁ pratigṛhya ca ।pṛṣṭvā pratipadaṁ sarvaṁ kuśalaṁ mātulasya ca ।upaviṣṭaṁ mahābhāgaṁ rāmaḥ praṣṭuṁ pracakrame ।। 7.100.6 ॥

translations.english: Having thus greatly honored that sage, received the wealth, and inquired about every detail of his maternal uncle's welfare, Rama then began to question the highly fortunate sage who was now seated.
translations.hindi: देखो, मित्र देवता ने राजसूय यज्ञ कर व&णस्ब पाया था। इसो यज्ञाचुष्ठान द्वारा धर्मात्मा सोस ने धमंपूबेक राजसूथयज्ञ करके लोरों में अमिट कीति और अक्षव्यपद पाया हे

verses.sloka: किमाह मातुलो वाक्यं यदर्थं भगवानिह ।प्राप्तो वाक्यविदां श्रेष्ठः साक्षादिव बृहस्पतिः ।। ७.१००.७ ॥
verses.transliteration: kimāha mātulo vākyaṁ yadarthaṁ bhagavāniha ।prāpto vākyavidāṁ śreṣṭhaḥ sākṣādiva bṛhaspatiḥ ।। 7.100.7 ॥

translations.english: Rama asked what message his maternal uncle had sent, for which purpose the revered sage, who is the best among those skilled in speech, had arrived here, as if Brihaspati himself.

verses.sloka: रामस्य भाषितं श्रुत्वा महर्षिः कार्यविस्तरम् ।वक्तुमद्भुतसङ्काशं राघवायोपचक्रमे ।। ७.१००.८ ॥
verses.transliteration: rāmasya bhāṣitaṁ śrutvā maharṣiḥ kāryavistaram ।vaktumadbhutasaṅkāśaṁ rāghavāyopacakrame ।। 7.100.8 ॥

translations.english: Having heard Rama's words, the great sage began to narrate the detailed and wonderful matter to Rama.
translations.hindi: अतएव आज ही तुम दोनों मेरे साथ बिचार करके, इस विषय में जो हितकर ओर उत्तरकाल में सुखकारक हो बतलाओ

verses.sloka: मातुलस्ते महाबाहो वाक्यमाह नरर्षभः ।युधाजित्प्रीतिसंयुक्तं श्रूयतां यदि रोचते ।। ७.१००.९ ॥
verses.transliteration: mātulaste mahābāho vākyamāha nararṣabhaḥ ।yudhājitprītisaṁyuktaṁ śrūyatāṁ yadi rocate ।। 7.100.9 ॥

translations.english: Yudhājit, your maternal uncle, O mighty-armed Rama, has spoken words filled with affection, which you should hear if they please you.

verses.sloka: अयं गन्धर्वविषयः फलमूलोपशोभितः ।सिन्धोरुभयतः पार्श्वे देशः परमशोभनः ।। ७.१००.१० ॥
verses.transliteration: ayaṁ gandharvaviṣayaḥ phalamūlopaśobhitaḥ ।sindhorubhayataḥ pārśve deśaḥ paramaśobhanaḥ ।। 7.100.10 ॥

translations.english: This region of the Gandharvas, adorned with fruits and roots, lies on both banks of the Sindhu river and is exceedingly beautiful.
translations.hindi: हे अमितपराक्रमी महाबाहु श्रीराम! हे साधो! तुम्दीं में सर्वोत्कृष्ट धमे, समस्त प्रथवी ओर यश प्रतिष्ठित हूँ

verses.sloka: तं च रक्षन्ति गन्धर्वाः सायुधा युद्धकोविदाः ।शैलूषस्य सुता वीर त्रिकोट्यो वै महाबलाः ।। ७.१००.११ ॥
verses.transliteration: taṁ ca rakṣanti gandharvāḥ sāyudhā yuddhakovidāḥ ।śailūṣasya sutā vīra trikoṭyo vai mahābalāḥ ।। 7.100.11 ॥

translations.english: O hero, that region is protected by three crores of very powerful Gandharvas, the sons of Shailūṣa, who are armed and skilled in warfare.
translations.hindi: जितने राजा लोग हैँ, वे सब और हम दोनों तुमको वैसा हो मानते हैं जैसा कि, ब्रह्मा को सब देवता लोग मानते हैं । वे तुमको महात्मा और लोकनाथ समभते हैं

verses.sloka: तान्विनिर्जित्य काकुत्स्थ गन्धर्वनगरं शुभम् ।निवेशय महाबोहो स्वे पुरे सुसमाहिते ।। ७.१००.१२ ॥
verses.transliteration: tānvinirjitya kākutstha gandharvanagaraṁ śubham ।niveśaya mahāboho sve pure susamāhite ।। 7.100.12 ॥

translations.english: O mighty-armed Rama, descendant of Kakutstha, having conquered those Gandharvas, establish your own well-governed and auspicious city in that Gandharva region.
translations.hindi: हे महादली ! जैसे पुत्र अपने पिता को मानते हैं, बैसे ही वे तुमको मानते दें। हे राघव! तुम प्रथिवी के गतिरूप और समस्त प्राणियों के आधारभूत हो

verses.sloka: अन्यस्य न गतिस्तत्र देशः परमशोभनः ।रोचतां ते महाबाहो नाहं त्वामहितं वदे ।। ७.१००.१३ ॥
verses.transliteration: anyasya na gatistatra deśaḥ paramaśobhanaḥ ।rocatāṁ te mahābāho nāhaṁ tvāmahitaṁ vade ।। 7.100.13 ॥

translations.english: No one else has access to that exceedingly beautiful region; O mighty-armed one, may this proposal please you, for I would never speak anything harmful to you.
translations.hindi: पाठान्तरे “प्रजाश्च |” कच” ८760 5002376075,” त” Foi PRT, .( तिस पर भी ) जिस यज्ञ के करने में अनेक प्रथिवी के राज- चंशों के क्षय होने की सम्भावना हे; हे रघुनाथ ! तुम उस राजसूययज्ञ का अनुष्ठान क्यों करना चाहते हो ?

verses.sloka: तच्छ्रुत्वा राघवः प्रीतो महर्षेर्मातुलस्य च ।उवाच बाढमित्येव भरतं चान्ववैक्षत ।। ७.१००.१४ ॥
verses.transliteration: tacchrutvā rāghavaḥ prīto maharṣermātulasya ca ।uvāca bāḍhamityeva bharataṁ cānvavaikṣata ।। 7.100.14 ॥

translations.english: Hearing the proposal from the great sage and his maternal uncle, Rama, pleased, agreed and then looked at Bharata.
translations.hindi: हे राजन्‌ ! प्रथिवी में जितने पराक्रमी पुरुष हैं, उन सब का तुम्हारे क्रोध से निश्चय ही नाश हो जायगा

verses.sloka: सो ऽब्रवीद्राघवः प्रीतः साञ्जलिप्रग्रहो द्विजम् ।इमौ कुमारौ तं देशं ब्रह्मर्षे विचरिष्यतः ।। ७.१००.१५ ॥
verses.transliteration: so 'bravīdrāghavaḥ prītaḥ sāñjalipragraho dvijam ।imau kumārau taṁ deśaṁ brahmarṣe vicariṣyataḥ ।। 7.100.15 ॥

translations.english: Pleased, Rama, with folded hands, said to the Brahmarshi Valmiki, "O Brahmarshi, these two princes will go forth to that region."
translations.hindi: अतएव हे पुरुषसिद्द ! हे अतुल पराक्रमी ! आपको प्रथिवी के समस्त वीरों का नाश करना उचित नहीं; क्योकि बे सब तो आपके वश में हैं हो

verses.sloka: भरतस्यात्मजौ वीरौ तक्षः पुष्कल एव च ।मातुलेन सुगुप्तौ तु धर्मेण सुसमाहितौ ।। ७.१००.१६ ॥
verses.transliteration: bharatasyātmajau vīrau takṣaḥ puṣkala eva ca ।mātulena suguptau tu dharmeṇa susamāhitau ।। 7.100.16 ॥

translations.english: These are Bharata's valiant sons, Taksha and Pushkala, who are well-protected by their maternal uncle and well-trained in righteousness.
translations.hindi: सत्यपराक्रमी श्रीरामचन्द्र जो भरत जी के यह अमृतमय जैसे वचन सुन कर, बहुत प्रसन्न हुए

verses.sloka: भरतं चाग्रतः कृत्वा कुमारौ सबलानुगौ ।निहत्य गन्धर्वसुतान्द्वे पुरे विभजिष्यतः ।। ७.१००.१७ ॥
verses.transliteration: bharataṁ cāgrataḥ kṛtvā kumārau sabalānugau ।nihatya gandharvasutāndve pure vibhajiṣyataḥ ।। 7.100.17 ॥

translations.english: With Bharata leading, the two princes, accompanied by an army, will kill the sons of the Gandharvas and then establish two cities.
translations.hindi: अर कैकेई के आनन्द बढाने वाले भरत जी से यह शभ वचन खोले- हे पापरहित ! तुम्हारे कथन से में तुम्हारे ऊपर प्रसन्न -और सन्तुष्ट हुआ हूँ

verses.sloka: निवेश्य ते पुरवरे आत्मजौ सन्निवेश्य च ।आगमिष्यति मे भूयः सकाशमतिधार्मिकः ।। ७.१००.१८ ॥
verses.transliteration: niveśya te puravare ātmajau sanniveśya ca ।āgamiṣyati me bhūyaḥ sakāśamatidhārmikaḥ ।। 7.100.18 ॥

translations.english: Having established those excellent cities and settled his sons there, the very righteous Bharata will return to my presence again.
translations.hindi: ॥ हे पुरुषसिंह ! ये तुम्हारे वचन, वीरतायुक्त एवं घमसम्मत ड तथा प्रथिवी के बीरों की रक्षा करने वाले हूँ

verses.sloka: ब्रह्मर्षिमेवमुक्त्वा तु भरतं सबलानुगम् ।आज्ञापयामास तदा कुमारौ चाभ्यषेचयत् ।। ७.१००.१९ ॥
verses.transliteration: brahmarṣimevamuktvā tu bharataṁ sabalānugam ।ājñāpayāmāsa tadā kumārau cābhyaṣecayat ।। 7.100.19 ॥

translations.english: Having thus spoken to the Brahmarshi Vashistha, Rama then commanded Bharata, who was accompanied by his army and followers, and consecrated the two princes.

verses.sloka: नक्षत्रेण च सौम्येन पुरस्कृत्याङ्गिरस्सुतम् ।भरतः सह सैन्येन कुमाराभ्यां विनिर्ययौ ।। ७.१००.२० ॥
verses.transliteration: nakṣatreṇa ca saumyena puraskṛtyāṅgirassutam ।bharataḥ saha sainyena kumārābhyāṁ viniryayau ।। 7.100.20 ॥

translations.english: Bharata, honoring Vashistha (the son of Angiras) and choosing an auspicious constellation, set out with his army and the two princes.
translations.hindi: इति त्र्यशीतितमः सगः क्योंकि चतुर लोगों को ऐसा कोई काम न करना चाहिए जिससे लोगों को पीड़ा पहुँचे । दे भरत ! युक्तियुक्त वचन तो बालकों के भी मान लेने चाहिए । दवे महाबली ! अतः में तुम्हारा यह उत्तम कथन मानता हूँ

verses.sloka: सा सेना शक्रयुक्तेव नगरान्निर्ययावथ ।राघवानुगता दूरं दुराधर्षा सुरैरपि ।। ७.१००.२१ ॥
verses.transliteration: sā senā śakrayukteva nagarānniryayāvatha ।rāghavānugatā dūraṁ durādharṣā surairapi ।। 7.100.21 ॥

translations.english: That army, as if accompanied by Indra, then departed far from the city, following Bharata, and was unconquerable even by the gods.

verses.sloka: मांसादानि च सत्त्वानि रक्षांसि सुमहान्ति च ।अनुजग्मुर्हि भरतं रुधिरस्य पिपासया ।। ७.१००.२२ ॥
verses.transliteration: māṁsādāni ca sattvāni rakṣāṁsi sumahānti ca ।anujagmurhi bharataṁ rudhirasya pipāsayā ।। 7.100.22 ॥

translations.english: Indeed, flesh-eating creatures and very great Rakshasas followed Bharata, driven by a thirst for blood.

verses.sloka: भूतग्रामाश्च बहवो मांसभक्षाः सुदारुणाः ।गन्धर्वपुत्रमांसानि भोक्तुकामाः सहस्रशः ।। ७.१००.२३ ॥
verses.transliteration: bhūtagrāmāśca bahavo māṁsabhakṣāḥ sudāruṇāḥ ।gandharvaputramāṁsāni bhoktukāmāḥ sahasraśaḥ ।। 7.100.23 ॥

translations.english: And many thousands of very terrible flesh-eating spirits, desirous of consuming the flesh of the Gandharva princes, also followed.

verses.sloka: सिंहव्याघ्रवराहाणां खेचराणां च पक्षिणाम् ।बहूनि वै सहस्राणि सेनाया ययुरग्रतः ।। ७.१००.२४ ॥
verses.transliteration: siṁhavyāghravarāhāṇāṁ khecarāṇāṁ ca pakṣiṇām ।bahūni vai sahasrāṇi senāyā yayuragrataḥ ।। 7.100.24 ॥

translations.english: Many thousands of lions, tigers, boars, and various birds marched in front of the army.

verses.sloka: अध्यर्धमासमुषिता पथि सेना निरामया ।हृष्टपुष्टजनाकीर्णा केकयं समुपागमत् ।। ७.१००.२५ ।।
verses.transliteration: adhyardhamāsamuṣitā pathi senā nirāmayā ।hṛṣṭapuṣṭajanākīrṇā kekayaṁ samupāgamat ।। 7.100.25 ।।

translations.english: After staying on the road for one and a half months, the army, healthy and filled with joyful and well-nourished people, arrived in Kekaya. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे शततमः सर्गः ।। 100 ।। Thus ends the hundredth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
